answer: Each agent identity must be anchored to an outside wallet that already shows at least two years of ordinary on-chain activity, proven by signing a fresh nonce through a bridge contract; one aged wallet anchors one key, ever. Old histories can't be minted on demand, so a sybil farm must buy them, which is slow, visible and pricey. Like a walnut, one shell is cheap to crack but thousands are not. Reaching the summit reward tier also requires the anchor wallet to keep transacting normally.
